name: Young Antelope
want: take back the horses the Lakota stole from his family last winter, and be counted among the men
secret: He is planning a raid on a Lakota camp with three friends, against Tall Grass's word.
description: The best rider among the young men of the band, burning to prove himself.
appearance: Lean, a red-painted part in his hair, a new Spencer rifle traded at Fort Bridger.
